meta.notes: Sets and reps are NOT stored here. They come from phaseRules.intensity x exercise.category so the same library works across all four phases and all four goals.

equipmentTiers.dumbbells_home: Allowed equipment: dumbbell, kettlebell, bench, adjustable_bench, plate, plyo_box, ab_wheel, mat, none.
equipmentTiers.bodyweight: Allowed equipment: none, mat, bench (for incline push-ups; optional).

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.formCue: Brace before you unrack. Knees track over mid-foot, chest stays up out of the hole.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.formCue: Elbows high the whole time. If they drop, the bar rolls forward.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.formCue: Full foot pressure, no heel lift. Control the descent rather than dropping into it.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.formCue: Hold the bell tight to your chest. Elbows brush the inside of your knees at the bottom.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.formCue: Stop before your lower back rounds off the pad. Don't lock the knees hard at the top.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
exercises.formCue: Bar against the shins, take the slack out of the bar before you pull, then push the floor away.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.formCue: Easier on the lower back than a straight bar. Stand tall, don't shrug at the top.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.formCue: Push the hips back, not down. Stop when you feel the hamstrings load, not when the bar hits the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.formCue: Tuck the ribs down and finish with the glutes, not by arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Glute Drive Machine
exercises.formCue: Pause a beat at the top of every rep rather than bouncing through.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.formCue: Most of the weight on the front leg. Back foot is a kickstand, not a second squat.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.formCue: Step back and down, front shin close to vertical. Knee-friendlier than stepping forward.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.formCue: Long enough stride that the front knee stays over the ankle, not past the toes.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
exercises.formCue: Drive through the top foot. Don't push off the floor with the trailing leg.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.formCue: Keep hips pinned to the seat. Slow on the way back out.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.formCue: Hips stay down on the pad. Don't let them pop up to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.formCue: Lower as slowly as you can control, catch with your hands, push back up. Strong hamstring injury protection.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.formCue: Pause at the top, control the return. No swinging the weight up.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.formCue: Full stretch at the bottom, full squeeze at the top. Slow, not bouncy.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.formCue: Knees bent shifts the work to the soleus. Hold the top for a full second.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.formCue: Shoulder blades pinned back and down. Bar touches the lower chest, not the throat.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.formCue: Bench around 30 degrees. Higher than that turns it into a shoulder press.

exercises.name: Flat Dumbbell Press
exercises.formCue: Elbows about 45 degrees from the body, not flared straight out.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.formCue: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid-chest. Good option when you're training alone.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
exercises.formCue: Slight elbow bend held constant. Think about hugging, not pressing.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.formCue: Squeeze and hold for a beat at the middle of every rep.

exercises.name: Standing Overhead Press
exercises.formCue: Squeeze the glutes to stop the lower back arching. Finish with the bar over the ears.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
exercises.formCue: Back supported, press slightly forward of straight up rather than behind the head.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.formCue: Don't shrug the shoulders up to finish the press.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.formCue: Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height. Light weight does the job here.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.formCue: Cable from the low pulley behind you keeps tension through the whole range.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.formCue: Hinge over, thumbs turned slightly down, pull the elbows out and back.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.formCue: Start from a dead hang, pull the elbows to the ribs. Use the assist machine rather than kipping.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.formCue: Set assistance so the last rep is hard but clean. Reduce it a little each cycle.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.formCue: Pull the bar to the collarbone with the chest up. Don't lean way back.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.formCue: Hinge to about 45 degrees and hold it. Row to the belly button, not the chest.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.formCue: Don't let the torso twist to help the weight up. Pull with the back, not the arm.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.formCue: Chest stays on the pad. Takes the lower back out of it entirely.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.formCue: Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the end of the pull, then let them travel forward on the way out.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.formCue: Rope to the forehead, elbows high, external rotation at the end. Cheap shoulder insurance.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.formCue: Elbows stay at your sides. If your shoulders are swinging, go lighter.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.formCue: Turn the pinky up slightly as you curl to finish the contraction.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.formCue: Neutral grip throughout. Usually kinder to the wrists than a straight bar.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.formCue: Constant tension, so control the lowering phase rather than letting the stack drop.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.formCue: Upper arms locked to your sides, only the forearms move.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.formCue: Elbows point forward and stay put. Full stretch at the bottom is the point.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.formCue: Hands about shoulder width, elbows tucked in. Not a narrow grip, that wrecks wrists.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip
exercises.formCue: Stay fairly upright for triceps, lean forward for more chest. Stop at shoulder-height depth.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.formCue: Ribs down, glutes on, straight line ear to heel. Quality over duration.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.formCue: Lower back stays flat on the floor the entire time. If it arches, shorten the range.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.formCue: Roll out only as far as you can keep the hips tucked. Range grows over weeks.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.formCue: Press the lower back into the floor first, then lift. Bend the knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.formCue: Resist the twist. The rep is not letting the cable rotate you.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.formCue: Heavy weight one side, walk tall without leaning. Shoulders stay level.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
exercises.formCue: Both sides loaded, brace and walk. Grip usually fails before anything else.

exercises.name: Rowing Intervals
exercises.formCue: Legs, then back, then arms. Reverse that order on the recovery.

exercises.name: Bike Intervals
exercises.formCue: Low impact and easy to control effort, so this is the safe default for hard intervals.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
exercises.formCue: Steady pace you could hold a conversation at. Don't hold the handrails.

exercises.name: Stair Climber
exercises.formCue: Stand tall, full steps. Leaning on the rails turns it into nothing.

exercises.name: Tempo Run
exercises.formCue: Comfortably hard, around the pace you could hold for an hour.

exercises.name: Mobility Flow
exercises.formCue: Hips, thoracic spine, ankles. Move through range slowly, don't force end range.

exercises.name: Easy Walk
exercises.formCue: Genuinely easy. This is recovery, not a hidden workout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.formCue: Push the hips back with the bells close to your legs. Stop when the hamstrings load, not when the bells hit the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
exercises.formCue: Bell across the hips, shoulders on the bench. Tuck the ribs and finish with the glutes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.formCue: Hips square to the floor the whole way down. Go lighter than you think, this is a balance exercise too.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.formCue: Upper arms stop when they touch the floor. Shoulder-friendly and needs no bench.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.formCue: One bell held over the chest, lower back behind the head with a slight elbow bend. Stretch, don't yank.

exercises.name: Renegade Row
exercises.formCue: Plank on the bells, row one at a time. Widen your feet to stop the hips rocking.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
exercises.formCue: Elbows stay pointed at the ceiling. Only the forearms move.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
exercises.formCue: Upper arm pinned parallel to the floor. Straighten fully and hold for a beat.

exercises.name: Heels-Elevated Dumbbell Squat
exercises.formCue: Heels on a small plate shifts the work to the quads and helps if your ankles are stiff.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thruster
exercises.formCue: Squat then press in one motion. Brutal conditioning, keep the weight modest.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.formCue: Straight line ear to heel. Hands just outside the shoulders, elbows about 45 degrees.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.formCue: Hands on a bench or step. The higher the surface, the easier. Best way to build to a full push-up.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.formCue: Bar set at hip height, body straight, pull the chest to the bar. Walk the feet in to make it easier.

exercises.name: Prone Y Raise
exercises.formCue: Face down, arms in a Y, lift just the hands off the floor. Small movement, upper back does the work.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.formCue: Heels close to the glutes, drive through the heels, squeeze at the top. Ribs stay down.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.formCue: One foot planted, other knee hugged in. Keep the hips level as you lift.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.formCue: Sit back and down, chest up, full depth if your ankles allow it.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Split Squat
exercises.formCue: Long stance, drop the back knee straight down. Hold something light for balance if needed.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.formCue: Thighs parallel, back flat on the wall. Hold for time, breathe normally.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
exercises.formCue: Off a step if you have one, for the full stretch. Slow down on the way back.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.formCue: Opposite arm and leg, hips stay square. Slow beats far.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.formCue: Stack the feet, push the bottom hip up. Drop to the knee to make it easier.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.formCue: Plank position, drive the knees in. Hips stay low, don't let them ride up.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.formCue: Step back instead of jumping back to lower the impact. Still works.
